buyer: UNITED STATES TRADE AND DEVELOPMENT AGENCY
title: IDIQ - Reverse Trade Missions, Conferences, Workshops, Trainings, and Other Events
description: USTDA requires a pool of qualified Contractors to plan, organize, and implement partnership-building activities that support the Agency�s mission, including reverse trade missions (RTMs), conferences, forums, workshops, trainings, and other events. Activities may take place anywhere in the United States or overseas and may be conducted in person, virtually, or in a hybrid format. USTDA may require multiple activities to be planned and implemented concurrently across different regions, sectors, and locations, including multiple events taking place simultaneously. Contractors must demonstrate the capacity and resources necessary to successfully manage and execute overlapping activities without compromising quality, responsiveness, or performance. Under this IDIQ, Contractors may be required to provide the full range of services necessary to successfully execute these activities. This includes, but is not limited to, event planning and project management; venue and vendor coordination; domestic and international travel and logistics; support for high-level foreign delegations and U.S. Government participants; participant recruitment, outreach, and registration; development of agendas, itineraries, and event materials; interpretation and translation; audiovisual and virtual event support; transportation, lodging, and other on-site logistics; and post-event monitoring, evaluation, data analysis, reporting, and closeout activities. Please see attached RFP for additional information regarding this solicitation.

title: Integrated Marketing Services – Japan
description: The purpose of this Negotiated Request for Proposal (the “NRFP”) is to solicit proposals from qualified proponents that can provide integrated marketing services primarily in Japan, while also demonstrating the expertise, resources, and operating flexibility to support Destination Canada in South Korea and China markets, as required. Proponents should demonstrate a strong understanding of tourism marketing, traveller demand, aviation and air-access dynamics, distribution and travel trade, and the broader factors affecting visitation from Asia to Canada. The successful proponent (the “Contractor”) achieves its goals through delivering effective strategic partnerships, media relations & public relations (MRPR), social media, consumer marketing, travel trade development, strategic industry engagement and event and experience management that grow awareness, consideration and conversion among DC’s Highly Engaged Guests (“HEGs”). The Contractor may engage qualified subcontractors to deliver executional services, where appropriate. The Contractor will remain fully responsible for the performance and quality of all services delivered by its subcontractors. See Statement of Work (Section C) for detailed requirements. It is DC’s intent to enter into an agreement with the proponent who can best serve the interests of DC. At the final outcome of the NRFP process, the successful proponent may be required to collaborate with DC’s other service providers and partners to ensure that public relations and communications services are consistent with DC’s mandate, brand and corporate strategy.

description: Sources Sought Fort Leavenworth Underground Fuel Tank Testing Services INTRODUCTION The Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC) is issuing this sources sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support the requirement for Underground Fuel Tank Testing and Maintenance on Fort Leavenworth, Kansas. The intention is to procure these services on a competitive basis. BASED ON THE REPSONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE AND THE MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE FOR SMALL BUISNESS (IN FULL OR IN PART) OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. Responses in any form are not offers and the Government is under no obligation to award a contract as a result of this announcement. No funds are available to pay for the preparation of responses to this announcement. Any information submitted by respondents to this technical description is strictly voluntary. Responses will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future notice or request, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the Government-Wide Point of Entry (GPE). There are ten (10) underground fuel storage tanks on Fort Leavenworth equipment with Veeder Root 350+ or 450+ monitoring systems, spill buckets, and overfill valves. title: ISBEE Solicitation: Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), non-personal healthcare services for Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) services equivalent to two full-time CNMs at Rosebud Service Unit, Rosebud IHS Hospital, Rosebud, South Dakota.
description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION � CERTIFIED NURSE-MIDWIFE SERVICES RFP No. 75H70627R00005 The Indian Health Service (IHS), Great Plains Area, is soliciting proposals for Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), non-personal Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) healthcare services at Rosebud IHS Hospital, Rosebud, South Dakota. This requirement is set aside for Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) under NAICS 561320, Temporary Help Services. The Contractor shall provide qualified CNM personnel sufficient to support two (2) full-time CNM positions providing outpatient obstetric, gynecological, prenatal, postpartum, family planning, and women�s primary care services, as well as obstetric emergency on-call coverage for the Emergency Department. The anticipated contract will use a Firm-Fixed-Price, Month-of-Service (MOS) pricing structure. One MOS represents complete monthly performance of the required CNM services in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS). The anticipated period of performance consists of a three (3)-month base period and three (3) option periods of three (3) months each, for a maximum potential period of performance of twelve (12) months. Services will be performed primarily at Rosebud IHS Hospital, Rosebud, South Dakota. Standard outpatient clinic hours are generally Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The requirement also includes shared 24-hour-per-day, 7-day-per-week CNM on-call availability for obstetric emergencies during non-clinic hours. Offerors shall provide qualified personnel meeting the education, certification, licensure, credentialing, privileging, background investigation, health, and other qualification requirements identified in the PWS. The Government intends to make award to the responsible Offeror whose proposal conforms to the solicitation requirements and represents the best value to the Government, price and other factors considered. Evaluation factors include Technical Capability, Past Performance, Management Approach, and Price. Applicable provisions and clauses, including FAR 52.212-1, FAR 52.212-2, FAR 52.212-4, and applicable FAR/HHSAR requirements, are incorporated by reference or provided in the solicitation and attachments. Prospective Offerors are responsible for reviewing the complete solicitation, PWS, price schedule, and all attachments prior to submission. Proposals are due November 6, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. CT.

All work will be performed in accordance with this SOW, the project documents as well as all applicable local, State, Federal and VA codes and standards.

title: Kitchen Equipment
description: THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AT THIS TIME. This request for capability information does not constitute a request for proposals; submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary; the government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. The West Virginia Army National Guard is issuing this Sources Sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a requirement for kitchen equipment and installation. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. PSC: 7310 Food Cooking, Baking, And Serving Equipment NAICS: 333310 Commercial and Service Industry Machinery Manufacturing Requirements: The Government requires the supply, delivery, and optional turnkey installation of commercial grade kitchen, cooking, baking, and serving equipment for a federal building cafeteria and food prep facility. Items will include but not limited to commercial ranges, convection/combi ovens, griddles, deep fryers, steam kettles, hot food holding cabinets, and stainless � steel prep tables/counters. All equipment must be NSF/ANSI certified for commercial sanitation and UL or ETL listed for gas/electrical safety. Must comply with Federal Energy Management Program (FEMP) guidelines and ENERGY STAR energy-efficiency certifications where applicable. Must comply with the Buy American Act / Trade Agreements Act as mandated by RFO FAR Part 25. Requires inside delivery, uncrating, inspection, placement at rough-in connection points, and removal/disposal of shipping dunnage at the designated federal site.

title: Construction of Chilled Water Plant and Site Utility Upgrades at VA Medical Center in West Haven, CT
description: The scope of the chilled water plant replacement consists of the demolition of the existing chilled water plant (building 16a) and construction of a new multi-story chilled water plant to include chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and all associated mechanical and electrical equipment. Due to the close proximity of the existing fuel tank farm adjacent to the existing chilled water plant, a new fuel tank farm will need to be constructed as part of the project, which primarily serves the central boiler plant, requiring close coordination with the medical center and ongoing related projects.The scope of the site utility upgrades consists of the replacement and upgrade of the existing fire protection water main and the domestic water main from Campbell Avenue to Building 15. Site utility upgrades also include providing utility main loops of chilled water supply and return, steam supply, condensate return, domestic water supply, and fire protection water supply which will originate from the new chilled water plant and back-feed to Building 1. The work also includes the installation of redundant electrical feeder from the utility demarcation point to Building 19 and coordination with the local electrical utility provider to provide further electrical redundancy offsite as well. In addition, new water storage tanks will be constructed. This project involves civil/site, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, geotechnical, and architectural disciplines. The project must also comply with the DVAs Physical Security Resiliency Design Requirements (PSRDM). It is expected that the chilled water plant will be constructed to meet USGBC LEED Silver certification. The work is located adjacent to and within an active Medical Center campus which will be operational at all times. Impact to on-going operations must be kept to a minimum and carefully coordinated with the Contracting Officer and VAMC staff. In addition, the work area is constrained due to the active medical center operations which will limit laydown and storage areas during construction.

title: JBMHH Gate Heaters & Fans Supply Rental
description: The Government intends to acquire a contract to provide eight (8) outdoor heaters and eight (8) misting fans, to be exchanged seasonally, for use at the access control points identified in the Specific Tasks section. All units will be operated outdoors and must be suitable for exposure to environmental elements. The Contractor shall provide, emplace, maintain, and recover all equipment. JBMHH will furnish fuel, water, and electricity necessary for operation. The Contractor shall inspect all equipment provided, including ensuring that all electrical cords are adequate and compatible with the required electrical supply. The contractor shall furnish all labor, tools, materials, and technical expertise required to perform diagnostics, repairs, replacements, and stabilization actions. Routine maintenance shall be conducted during standard business hours; however, the contractor must maintain continuous on-call support to respond to critical failures such as electrical hazards, complete equipment shutdown, or conditions that render the gate unsafe or inoperable. All work shall comply with applicable Army, DoD, and installation safety standards, ensuring uninterrupted support to access control operations.

The subject item requires Government source approval prior to contract award, as the item is flight critical and/or the technical data available has not been determined adequate to support procurement via full and open competition. Only the source(s) previously approved by the Government will be solicited. The time required for approval of a new source is normally such that an award cannot be delayed pending approval of a new source. If you are not an approved source you must submit, together with your proposal, the information detailed in the NAVSUP Source Approval Information Brochure for spare. This brochure identifies technical data required to be submitted based on your company's experience in manufacture/repair of the same or similar items. Code 4: Part redesigned - Old and new parts are completely interchangeable. Code 5: Part redesigned - New part replaces old. Old part cannot replace new. Code 6: Part redesigned - Parts not interchangeable. 3.4 Mercury Free - The material supplied under this contract/purchase order is intended for use on submarines/surface ships and therefore shall contain no metallic mercury and shall be free from mercury contamination. Mercury contamination of the material will be cause for rejection. If the inclusion of metallic mercury is required as a functional part of the material furnished under this contract, the Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Procurement Contracting Officer before proceeding with manufacture. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. These requirements shall be included in any subcontract or purchase order hereunder and the Contractor shall insure SubContractor compliance with these requirements. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. For background, the following information is provided: Mercury is corrosive to gold, silver, nickel, stainless steels, aluminum and copper alloys.

Award of the proposed contract action will not be delayed while an unauthorized source seeks to obtain authorization. G. The Government is requesting a Repair Turnaround Time (RTAT) of 88 days after receipt of asset. Repair Turnaround Time (RTAT) definition: The resultant contractual delivery requirement is measured from asset Return to the date of asset acceptance under the terms of the contract. For purposes of this section, Return is defined as physical receipt of the F-condition asset at the contractor?s facility as reflected in the Action Date entry in the Commercial Asset Visibility (CAV) system. In accordance with the CAV Statement of Work, the contractor is required to accurately report all transactions by the end of the fifth regular business day after receipt and the Action Date entered in CAV must be dated to reflect the actual date of physical receipt. title: AMS Designated Laboratory Meat Testing Services (ADL)
description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) is issuing Solicitation 12?1NTS?26?R?0002 to obtain proposals from responsible, accredited analytical laboratories to perform microbiological and fat testing in support of AMS meat, poultry, egg, and aquatic product procurement programs. This requirement establishes AMS Designated Laboratories (ADLs) responsible for conducting all required microbiological and chemical analyses on samples submitted by AMS vendors, ensuring compliance with Federal Purchase Program Specifications (FPPS) and supporting food safety and quality verification efforts. AMS intends to award an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) firm?fixed?price contract, consisting of a Base Period and up to four option periods, covering performance from April 1, 2027 through March 31, 2032. Offerors must be fully capable of meeting all technical, accreditation, reporting, and quality assurance requirements outlined in the Statement of Work (SOW) and must maintain ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation for all applicable microbiological and chemical test methods throughout the contract term. Offerors are required to submit a complete proposal package in accordance with Section E of the solicitation, including all technical, management, past performance, and pricing components, as well as a properly completed and signed SF?1449. Offerors must ensure all requirements, instructions, and submission details�such as WBSCM electronic submission processes�are fully reviewed and followed. Incomplete proposals may not be considered for award. Key expectations under this solicitation include: � Performance of all required microbiological and fat analyses using approved methods (FSIS MLG, AOAC, AOCS, or AMS?approved alternatives). � Comprehensive sample preparation, receipt, testing, reporting, and data management in accordance with AMS SOW requirements. � Timely reporting of results, including notification of presumptive or confirmed pathogen positives to AMS, FSIS, and vendors. � Secure handling and management of proprietary AMS data. � Full compliance with FAR, AGAR, and USDA?specific contract clauses incorporated into the solicitation. Prospective offerors are strongly encouraged to read the entire solicitation package, including the SOW, exhibits, and all referenced clauses, to ensure a complete and conforming submission.

title: Request For Proposal (RFP) NASA Agency-wide Acquisition of Nitrogen and Oxygen 4 (NANO 4)
description: UPDATE - 10/07/2026 The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) John F. Kennedy Space Center is pleased to release the 2027 NASA Agency-wide Acquisition of Nitrogen and Oxygen (NANO) 4 opt-in opportunity as described in the original NANO 4 Request for Proposal (RFP), Sections 2.9, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in, and 2.9.2, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The NANO 4 RFP was issued on March 4, 2024, and the original solicitation (as revised) remains open throughout the ordering period through the use of innovative provisions as prescribed in Section 2, Clause 2.9, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in, and Clause 2.9.2, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The NANO 4 contract�s ordering period remains valid through June 30, 2029. The RFP resulted in the award of six indefinite delivery (ID) fixed price with Economic Price Adjustment (FPEPA) requirements contracts with fixed price delivery orders for the supply of liquid nitrogen and liquid oxygen in support of operations at agency centers and facilities across the United States. title: Integrated GOTS/NDI Systems and COTS Modular Enablers & Building Blocks
description: The Air Force Research Laboratory, Tech Transition Office AFRL/RR, in coordination with the Information and Spectrum Warfare Directorate (AFRL/RI), is seeking information from industry to improve USAF understanding of domestic market capabilities and identify qualified vendors to collaborate with. Specifically, AFRL is investigating technologies small enough to be installed on Group 2-3 unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) across two core pathways: 1. Integrated GOTS/NDI Systems: Existing Government-Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) or Non- Developmental Item (NDI) radar electronic attack (EA) systems that have been proven or demonstrated for military use. 2. COTS Modular Enablers & Building Blocks: Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) hardware, open software-defined architectures, and high-performance RF components. AFRL is highly interested in innovative commercial building blocks�including Radio Frequency System on Chip (RFSoC) technology, high-speed analog-to-digital converters, and edge compute chips�that can support receive, process, and transmit capabilities in a variety of active and passive military scenarios.

title: Blanket Purchase Agreement of Laboratory Analyses Services for Worldwide Support
description: AMENDMENT 0003: this combined synopsis / solicitation has been amended, and the Small Business set-aside category has been removed, upon consultation with the Small Business Administration, in order to promote more robust competition for these requirements, where the Government still intends to award multiple agreements for the requirement (as denoted in the attachment). Additionally, the ELIN attachment (Lab Services) have been updated again, with further changes in the line items, at the discretion of the Contracting Office as advised. Furthermore, this Amendment incorporates key changes to the regualtions used, per new policy to apply the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) standards, including the 48 CFR Ch. 2 deviations (i.e. DFARS). As a result of all the changes applied by Amendment 0003, any offeror that has previously submitted quotes for consideration will have to provide a new quote package, to include both ELINs and the required RFO provisions with representations, but these vendors are still elible for award consideration and authorized to participate. At this time, the original proposal due date has been extended to November 6th, 2026; were the Contracting Officer to issue any further amendments to the proposal information, they will be posted to this same public record for widest and most-timely distribution. AMENDMENT 0002: these changes updated the set-aside status, and the ELINs, and both have been superseded. AMENDMENT 0001: responses to RFI were posted for the RFI event, and historical data of the Contracting Office for informational purposes has been posted as well. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the format at RFO 12.202(b)(1) [Updated], as supplemented with additional information included in this notice (attachments). This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. The requiring activity has determined that establishment of Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPA) is both appropriate and would be advantageous, and as a result quotes are being sought for the establishment of long-term agreements as a result. Interested vendors shall prepare to furnish laboratory analyses services and associated laboratory supplies, if and when requested by the Contracting Officer (or the authorized Representative of the Contracting Officer) anticipated as (but limited to) five one-year periods starting in 2026. Attached to this advertisement are pre-award evaluation procedures, proposal requirements for responsiveness and responsibility determinations, and a full set of objectives and standards for future ordering and performance. The solicitation utilizes source selection procedures which require offerors to submit a technical proposal, past performance and experience information, and pricing quotes for evaluation by the Government; details of submittal and evaluation are listed at provisions 52.212-1 and 52.212-2, respectively. Additionally, please make note of the mandatory format for quoting pricing of laboratory analyses services and directly-associated laboratory supplies. Note: copies of NAVFAC Past Performance Questionnaire (PPQ) forms have been newly posted in the attachments as of December 29, 2025; in accordance with Federal regulations, the Government's preferred source of past performance are records at CPARS.gov (see RFO Subpart 42.11 [Updated]), but these PPQ forms may be used for state, municipal, and/or private sector projects that are appropriate as past performance. The Government may award an agreement to up to three (3) Contractors, at the Government's discretion and convenience. title: Engineering Services for the B-52H Stratofortress
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL/QUOTE. This synopsis is not to be construed as a commitment on the part of the Government to award a contract nor does the Government intend to directly pay for any information or responses submitted as a result of this solicitation. This is a Sources Sought Synopsis; there is no solicitation available at this time. This Sources Sought Synopsis is published for market research purposes only. Companies may be contacted if further information is needed. This announcement constitutes a Sources Sought Synopsis to seek a contractor for future work pertaining to the B-52H engineering services starting 01 January 2028. The Boeing B-52H Stratofortress is an American long-range subsonic jet-powered strategic bomber. The B-52 was designed and built by Boeing, which has continued to provide support and upgrades. It has been operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) since 1955 and was flown by NASA from 1959 to 2007. The bomber can carry up to 70,000 pounds (32,000 kg) of weapons and has a typical combat range of around 8,800 miles (14,200 km) without aerial refueling. The sustainment of the B-52H currently includes the delivery of engineering design, engineering support, and technical support services crucial for the ongoing maintenance and operational readiness of the B-52H aircraft, including its components and associated support and test equipment. The original estimated minimum/maximum amount for the B-52H sustainment contracts was $1.15B over ten (10) years (2019-2028) for engineering services Contract efforts are subject to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.232-18 availability of funds. The sustainment contracts currently contain multiple contract types at the contract line-item level (e.g. firm fixed price, cost plus incentive fee, cost plus fixed fee, etc.) This Sources Sought Synopsis only addresses the B-52H engineering services requirements starting 01 January 2029. The contractor will be required to provide engineering support services that provide technical information and logistics resources to enable maintenance and operational readiness of 76 B-52H aircraft. Engineering services will be required at the following USAF operational bases: Tinker AFB, Oklahoma; Edwards AFB, California; Minot AFB, North Dakota, and Barksdale AFB, Louisiana. Additionally, the contractor shall provide engineering support at the Boeing facility Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, to reflect field service representative (FSR) support. The contractor will be required to perform the following recurring engineering services: - Program Management and Integration - Principal Point of Contact - Platform Website - Meetings, briefings, conferences, reviews, and Technical Interchange Meeting (TIMs) - Structures Working Group - Government Property and Material Management - Unique Identifier (UID) Requirements - Configuration Management - Data management, automation and Contract data Requirements Delivery (CDRL) and CDRL Quality - Engineering Data/Documents Files - Quality Assurance Program - Engineering Support - Aircraft Structural Integrity Program (ASIP) - Specialized Engineering Support - System Integration Lab (SIL) - Ground and Flight Test Engineering Support - Drawing Cleanup and Procurement Ready Drawing - Programmed Depot Maintenance (PDM) Repair Development - Voluntary Protection Program - Field Services Representative (FSR) The contractor will be required to perform the following Non-recurring Engineering (NRE) services support: - Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Statement of Work (SOW) - Expedited Acquisitioin Process (EAP) and Engineering Projects (EP) - Interim Contractor Support (ICS) - Over & Above (O&A) - Travel - Material - Data Requirements - Meetings, briefings, conferences, reviews, and Technical Interchange Meeting (TIMs) - Associate Contractors and Proprietary Information Agreements (PIA) - Quality Assurance and Quality Management System - Safety - System Engineering - Diminishing Manufacturing Sources (DMS) - Earned Value management (EVM)s - Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) It is critical that respondents include the degree to which they will require access to B-52H rights and the degree to which they have or are able to obtain B-52H rights from Boeing. The capabilities package should be brief and concise yet clearly demonstrate an ability to meet the stated requirements. Recent, relevant experience should be provided for each area. If a company is capable of some, but not all of the consolidated requirements stated in this Sources Sought Synopsis, please provide a response that explains the requirements for which you are capable. Teaming and/or subcontracting arrangements should be clearly delineated and previous experience in teaming must be provided. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this action is 541330, size standard is $25.5 million. Firms responding to this announcement should indicate whether they are a large business, other than small business, small business, small disadvantaged business (SDB), woman-owned small business (WOSB), economically disadvantaged women-owned small business (EDWOSB), 8(a)-certified business, service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), veteran-owned small business (VOSB), or Historically Underutilized Business Zone small business (HUBZone). All prospective contractors shall be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database to be awarded a DoD contract. Note that the NAICS code for this requirement, if applicable to the company's capabilities, should be included in the company's NAICS code listing in SAM (www.sam.gov). The acquisition strategy has not yet been determined. Market research results will assist the Air Force in determining whether this requirement will be a full and open, a small business (or other socioeconomic) set aside, or a sole source acquisition. Note that, if there is sufficient demonstrated interest and capability among small business contractors, a key factor in determining if an acquisition will be a Small Business Set-Aside is that two or more potential small business prime contractors must be capable of performing at least 50% of the effort, as defined in FAR clause 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting. If it is determined that a small business set-aside is appropriate and your company anticipates submitting a proposal as the prime contractor for a small business set-aside, please provide specific details and rationale as to how compliance with FAR clause 52.219-14 would be achieved, including specific details regarding teaming arrangements, etc. If subcontracts are to be used, provide anticipated percentage of effort to be subcontracted and whether small or large businesses will be used. Teaming and/or subcontracting arrangements should be clearly delineated and previous experience in teaming must be provided. It is anticipated that appropriate security classifications for personnel and facilities will be required up to the Secret level in satisfying these performance requirements. It is also anticipated that the contractor will require access to special access information, receive and generate classified material and fabricate, modify or store classified hardware. Appropriate security requirements will be required before contract award. Companies may be contacted for further information as required to assess their capabilities. The B-52 Contracting Branch is surveying the market to determine if any sources are qualified to fulfil any or all the above-mentioned requirements. Interested firms should submit sufficient information (limit to 20 pages � 12-point font, single-spaced, 1" margins) which will permit assessment of technical capabilities in writing or electronically to Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, AFLCMC/WBK, Attn. Mr. Kurt McKay, 3001 Staff Drive, Tinker AFB, OK 73145. If there are any questions with regard to the contract please contact Kurt McKay, Contract Negotiator, AFLCM

title: 380 kV, Bonaduz-Sils (GR), remplacement des pylônes avifaune
description:
Les travaux de génie civil comprennent la réalisation ou le renforcement des fondations pour huit emplacements de pylônes. Pour sept pylônes, les fondations existantes seront agrandies, assainies et renforcées au moyen de micropieux. En raison de sa proximité avec un cours d’eau de surface, le pylône 1261x005 sera déplacé d’environ 40 m en direction du pylône 1261x004 et sera doté, à son nouvel emplacement, d’une fondation entièrement nouvelle renforcée au moyen de micropieux. Le pylône 1261x005 sera en outre rehaussé de 4 m et le pylône 1261x019 de 9 m.

L’étendue des prestations comprend notamment les travaux de démolition et de sécurisation nécessaires, l’aménagement des accès au chantier et des voies d’accès temporaires, les travaux d’excavation et de stabilisation des talus, la réalisation de micropieux, les travaux de bétonnage et de fondation, les travaux de mise à la terre ainsi que la remise en état complète des surfaces utilisées. Les montants d’angle des nouveaux pylônes de la ligne seront scellés dans les fondations en béton.

Les travaux seront réalisés en partie dans des zones sensibles du point de vue paysager et écologique ainsi que sur des terrains difficiles d’accès et escarpés. Les prescriptions spécifiques à chaque site concernant la protection de la nature, du paysage, des eaux et des sols, ainsi que les surfaces autorisées pour les accès, les installations de chantier et les travaux, doivent impérativement être respectées lors de l’exécution.


Pour des raisons géographiques, l’appel d’offres relatif aux travaux de génie civil est subdivisé en deux lots, comprenant chacun quatre emplacements de pylônes.


L’étendue détaillée des prestations ainsi que les exigences et les quantités spécifiques au projet figurent dans les documents d’appel d’offres.

title: Planificateur général SIA 32-53 pour la sous-station de Regensdorf
description:
La sous-station de 220 kV de Regensdorf est située dans la commune de Regensdorf, dans le canton de Zurich.


L'installation de commutation de 220 kV à isolation gazeuse de la sous-station de Regensdorf a été mise en service en 2021. Malgré le jeune âge de l'installation à isolation gazeuse (5 ans), celle-ci ne peut pas, selon le fabricant, être étendue avec le même type d'installation. Une pièce d'adaptation fabriquée sur mesure est nécessaire pour pouvoir procéder à l'extension vers un type d'installation actuel. Cela s'accompagne d'un besoin d'espace plus important, raison pour laquelle Swissgrid a décidé d'agrandir directement l'installation de deux baies. À cette fin, l'installation GIS doit être agrandie de deux baies (baie de transformateur et baie de réserve), ainsi que des raccordements de câbles nécessaires.


Le présent appel d'offres vise à recruter le planificateur général pour les phases SIA 32 à 53 afin d'assurer la planification et la coordination de ce projet, les phases SIA 51 à 53 étant attribuées à titre optionnel. Outre l'étendue des prestations spécifiques à son domaine de compétence, le maître d'œuvre assume également la supervision et la coordination générales de tous les domaines spécialisés impliqués, y compris les interfaces associées, en tant que responsable général au sens de la norme SIA 103.


Les sous-projets suivants doivent être organisés par le planificateur général:


  • Direction et coordination de tous les domaines spécialisés impliqués, y compris les interfaces
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le sous-projet - Techniques des circuits primaires
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le sous-projet - Besoins propres
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le sous-projet - Bâtiment et génie civil
  • Direction des trauvaux (facultatif)


Les sous-projets suivants sont mis à la disposition du planificateur général:


  • Coordination générale des modèles BIM
  • Ingénierie et planifcation dans le sous-projet - Système d'automatisation des sous-stations (SAS)
  • Conception et planification dans le sous-projet - Environnement



Pour plus d'informations, veuillez consulter les documents C100 et C101 du dossier d'appel d'offres.

title: Udbud af kontrakt om scanning, opmåling og 3D modellering af Danmarks Fængslers samlede ejendomsportefølje
description: Styrelsen for Danmarks Fængsler har som led i en ny digitaliseringsstrategi besluttet at igangsætte et projekt med henblik på at få scannet, opmålt og 3D-modelleret Danmarks Fængslers samlede ejendomsportefølje. Det primære formål med projektet er at få valideret Danmarks Fængslers arealer og anvendelse af disse. Derudover er formålet med, scanningen, opmålingen og modelleringen at etablere et digitalt og datadrevet fundament for fremtidig ejendomsdrift, vedligehold, planlægning og udvikling. Projektet omfatter scanning, opmåling og opbygning af 3D-modeller (Revit/IFC), som skal kunne integreres i det nyligt indkøbte FM system (Dalux FM). title: Germany – Security services – Empfangs- und Sicherheitsdienstleistungen

Um neue Lösungsansätze aus dem Labor schnellstmöglich zum Menschen zu bringen, arbeiten die Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler in einer Kombination von experimenteller und angewandter Forschung: Von Zelle und Maus, über epidemiologische Beobachtungen, bis hin zu humanen Interventionen. Das DIfE beabsichtigt Empfangs- und Sicherungsdienstleistungen nach § 34a GewO und sicherungstechnische Überwachungsleistungen im Objektschutz gemäß nachfolgender Ausschreibung zum 21.02.2027 an einen externen Dienstleister zu vergeben. Die ordnungsgemäße Übernahme der Leistung vom bisherigen Dienstleister ist Bestandteil der Ausschreibung, eine entsprechende Übernahmephase ist mit auszuweisen. Die Leistungsdauer beträgt zwei Jahre mit der Option einer zweimaligen Verlängerung um jeweils 12 Monate. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind personelle Sicherungsdienstleistungen im Objektschutz in Form der betrieblichen Objektbewachung mit Tor- und Empfangsdienst sowie Streifen- und Interventionsdienst, der Bewachung und Überwachung von Forschungs-, Büroeinrichtungen und Lagern. Dazu zählt die Prävention gegen alle Formen potentieller Angriffe insbesondere auf die Objekte und ihren Inhalt, das Eigentum und Vermögen mit Intervention bei Alarmmeldungen sowie sonstigen Vorkommnissen. An die interne und externe Intervention werden besondere qualitative Ansprüche gestellt.

title: Germany – Pipelaying construction work – Ertüchtigungs- bzw. Neubaumaßnahmen der Anlagentechnik in drei FW-Netzstationen sowie die Errichtung eines dazu erforderli-chen Gebäudes im Versorgungsgebiet der Energienetze Offenbach GMBH
description: Los 1: Neubau Gebäude NS1 am EW Gegenstand dieses Projekts ist die Planung und Realisierung eines Gebäudes zur Einbrin-gung der Anlagentechnik einer Fernwärmestation (FW-NS1) für die Wärmeauskopplung aus dem EVO- Energiewerk (EW). Dabei handelt es sich um ein eingeschossiges Hallengebäude mit Flachdach in Stahlträger Bauweise auf einer Stahlbeton Bodenplatte. Die Fassade besteht aus einer Wärme- Schallgedämmten Kassettenwand mit Trapezbleichverkleidung sowie ei-nem Warmdach in der gleichen Bauweise. Ein eingeschobener Baukörper aus Stahlbeton-wänden mit Decke beinhaltet dabei die Nebenräume. Ebenso gefordert ist die notwendige technische Gebäudeausstattung (Strom, Wasser & Abwasser, Lüftung bzw. Klimatisierung), alle Zugänge, wie Türen, Rolltore etc. und die Ausrüstung mit Fenstern. Los 2: Ausführungsplanung und Erstellen Anlagentechnik mit Materiallieferung für NS1 EW Gegenstand dieses Projekts ist die Planung und Realisierung einer Fernwärmestation (FW-NS1) für die Wärmeauskopplung aus dem EW (Primärseite) und die Wärmeübergabe inkl. der Netzpumpen an drei Fernwärmenetze (Sekundärseite), die jeweils mit einer Vor- und Rück-laufleitung an die FW-NS1 anbinden. Ebenso die Errichtung der Unterspannungsversorgung gemäß Projektbeschreibung. Die zu versorgenden Fernwärmenetze sind das Versorgungs-netz Offenbach (Netz OF) mit einer maximalen Wärmeabgabe von ca. 70 MW, das Versor-gungsnetz Gravenbruch (Netz GR) mit einem maximalen Wärmebedarf von ca. 15 MW und das Versorgungsnetz Heusenstamm (Netz HEU) mit einem maximalen Wärmebedarf von ca. 5 MW. Die maximale Wärmeleistung der FW-NS beträgt somit ca. 90 MW und wird durch Plat-tenwärmetauschern 2 x 35 MW und 2 x 25 MW von der Primär- auf die Sekundärseite über-tragen. Die Wärmetauscher trennen die Primär- von der Sekundärseite hydraulisch. Auf der Sekundärseite sind 3 baugleiche Netzpumpen vorgesehen, die für die Umwälzung der Fern-wärmenetze wahlweise genutzt werden können. Die Wärmeabgabe aus dem EW an die FW-NS1 erfolgt auf zwei unterschiedlichen Tempera-turniveaus (Nieder- und Hochtemperatur) durch jeweils einer Vor- und Rücklaufleitung zwi-schen EW und FW-NS1. Das Hochtemperatur-Niveau beträgt primärseitig bis zu 126 °C und ca. 90 MW Wärmeleistung. Das Niedertemperatur-Niveau beträgt primärseitig bis zu 98 °C und ca. 25 MW Wärmeleistung. Die Anbindung Vor- und Rücklaufleitung für die Niedertempe-ratur an das EW wird zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt realisiert, jedoch innerhalb der FW-NS1 bereits umgesetzt. Bei außer Betrieb befindlicher NS1 EW, soll ein Bypass innerhalb der Station als Verbindung der Netze OF und GR/HEU genutzt werden, wobei der Rest der FW-NS1 außer Betrieb ist. Hierzu ist es erforderlich die Druckerhöhungsstation Lauterborn (NS4), die sich im Stadtteil Lauterborn (LTB) im Netz OF befindet, ebenfalls zu erneuern. Zudem ist die Aufgaben der NS4, das Aufrechterhalten der Fernwärmenetzhydraulik nach Leistungssteigerung. Die NS 4 wird getrennt, im Los 3 betrachtet. Los 3: Ausführungsplanung und Erstellen Anlagenbau NS4- Lauterborn Gegenstand dieses Projekts ist die Um- Planung und Realisierung der vorhandenen Drucker-höhungsstation NS4 in Lauterborn. Ebenso die Errichtung der Unterspannungsversorgung gemäß Projektbeschreibung. Dazu gehört ebenfalls teilweise die Demontage der Alten Anlage mit Entsorgung. Zum Betrieb der Netzstation NS1- EW und der NS7 am SANA-Klinikum ist die NS4 Hydraulisch- und Versorgungstechnisch zwingend notwendig. Mittels zweier Pumpen sowohl im Vorlauf als auch im Rücklauf der Fernwärme Haupttransportleitung werden die hyd-raulisch notwendigen Betriebs- bzw. Netzparameter realisiert . Los 4: Ausführungsplanung und Erstellen Anlagenbau NS7- SANA Klinikum Gegenstand dieses Projekts ist die Um- Planung und Realisierung der vorhandenen Drucker-höhungsstation NS7 im SANA-Klinikum. Ebenso die Errichtung der Unterspannungsversor-gung gemäß Projektbeschreibung. Dazu gehört ebenfalls teilweise die Demontage der Alten Anlage mit Entsorgung. Zum Betrieb der Netzstationen NS1- EW und NS4 Lauterborn ist die NS7 Hydraulisch- und Versorgungstechnisch zwingend notwendig. Mittels einer Pumpe im Rücklauf der Fernwärme Haupttransportleitung und Überström-Regelventilen werden die hyd-raulisch notwendigen Betriebs- bzw. Netzparameter realisiert.

buyer: Klinikum der Stadt Ludwigshafen am Rhein gGmbH
title: Germany – Medical equipments – Radionuklidlabor
description: Das Department für Nuklearmedizin und Theranostik hat seine Tätigkeit mit dem Ziel aufgenommen, das Fachgebiet Nuklearmedizin am Klinikum Ludwigshafen aufzubauen und dauerhaft zu etablieren. Dazu gehören die radiochemischen, qualitätssichernden und dosimetrischen Strukturen für die diagnostischen und insbesondere therapeutischen Zwecke in stationärer und ambulanter Konstellation. Die gegenständliche Beschaffungsmaßnahme umfasst neben der konzeptionellen Planung eine integrierte und zukunftsfähige Infrastruktur für theranostische und individualisierte Therapie- und Ambulanzkonzepte in zwei Ausbaustufen und wird unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen des § 13 AMG umgesetzt. Die erste Ausbaustufe umfasst die Schaffung der infrastrukturellen und technischen Voraussetzungen für die aseptische Vorbereitung unter Laminar-Flow-Bedingungen sowie für die Qualitätssicherung der therapeutisch eingesetzten, kommerziell verfügbaren Radiopharmaka. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt bereits in dieser frühen Phase auf der Integration qualitätssichernder Maßnahmen und Prozesse. Die Qualitätssicherung wird von Beginn an als zentraler Bestandteil des Arbeitsablaufs implementiert, um die Sicherheit, Rückverfolgbarkeit, Reproduzierbarkeit und regulatorische Konformität aller Schritte zu gewährleisten und einen flexiblen Einsatz der kommerziell verfügbaren Radiopharmaka im klinischen Alltag zu ermöglichen. Darüber hinaus schafft diese Ausbaustufe die Grundlage für die SPECT/CT-basierte Bestimmung der Therapieaktivität mit Gamma und Beta-Strahler sowie dosimetrischer Auswertungen im Rahmen von individualisierten Therapien. In der zweiten - optionalen - Ausbaustufe des Radionuklidlabors erfolgt die Erweiterung des Radionuklidlabors zu einer GMP-like Infrastruktur, die technisch und strukturell vollständig mit den bereits geschaffenen Voraussetzungen in der ersten Ausbaustufe kompatibel ist. Ziel ist die Etablierung qualitätsgesicherter Prozesse für die aseptische Eigenherstellung und Freigabe von Radiopharmaka und Erweiterung des therapeutischen Spektrums durch Alfa-Therapien und GMP-Konforme individualisierte Behandlungskonzepte. Hierfür sind die Bereitstellung eines Isolators mit Vorkammern und Synthesemodul sowie eines H2O2-Generators für die aseptische Herstellung und Abfüllung im klinischen Routinebetrieb vorgesehen. Die Erweiterung stärkt die Qualitätssicherung, erhöht die therapeutische Flexibilität und ermöglicht eine langfristige Patientenversorgung am Standort über Behandlungskonzepte mit kommerziell verfügbaren Radiopharmaka hinaus. Der Auftraggeber behält sich vor, die zweite Ausbaustufe im Anschluss an die erste Ausbaustufe nicht oder nur in Teilen zu beauftragen. Der Auftragnehmer hat keinen Anspruch auf die Beauftragung dieser Leistung. Weitere vom Auftragsgegenstand umfasste Leistungen sind die Planung und Konzeption der beiden Ausbaustufen, sowie Service- und Wartungsleistungen für die Dauer von acht Jahren ab Inbetriebnahme der Geräte. title: Denmark – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Hovedentreprise vedrørende transformation af dele af Det Kongelige Palæ og den tilhørende Palæhave til Roskilde Domkirke Verdensarvscenter
description: Ejendomsfonden Roskilde Domkirke Verdensarvscenter inviterer kvalificerede hovedentreprenører til at ansøge om prækvalifikation til udførelsen af en nænsom transformation af dele af Det Kongelige Palæ og den tilhørende Palæhave. Det fredede, statsejede barokanlæg er tegnet af Lauritz de Thurah i 1730’erne og ligger ved Roskilde Domkirke. Cobe er totalrådgiver på projektet. Verdensarvscenteret skal formidle domkirkens arkitektur, kongelige historie og betydning som verdensarv med høj faglig kvalitet og gøre fortællingerne nærværende for besøgende på tværs af generationer. Centeret skal indrettes med tidssvarende publikumsfaciliteter og fleksible udstillingsrum. Projektet realiseres med støtte fra A.P. Møller og Hustru Chastine Mc-Kinney Møllers Fond til almene Formaal, Augustinus Fonden, Roskilde Kommune, Kulturministeriet samt Dronning Margrethes og Prins Henriks Fond. // Hovedentreprisen omfatter de bygge- og anlægsarbejder, leverancer og nødvendige biydelser, der er beskrevet i udbudsmaterialet. Udstillingsarbejderne gennemføres af en særskilt totalentreprenør og indgår ikke i den udbudte hovedentreprise. Opgaven kræver særlig agtpågivenhed og erfaring med udførelse i fredede eller bevaringsværdige bygninger, herunder koordinering af arbejder og tekniske løsninger i historiske konstruktioner. Hovedentreprenøren skal inden byggeriets opstart medvirke aktivt ved færdiggørelsen og koordineringen af udførelsesprojektet i samarbejde med totalrådgiveren, bygherren og totalentreprenøren for udstillingsarbejderne. Arbejderne udbydes på grundlag af det projektmateriale, der fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Totalrådgiveren varetager projekteringsledelsen og koordineringen af parternes bidrag. Hovedentreprenørens medvirken omfatter deltagelse i nødvendige møder, afklaring af grænseflader samt rettidig udarbejdelse og tilretning af nødvendigt produktionsgrundlag, herunder arbejds- og produktionstegninger, arbejdsplaner, kvalitetssikringsmateriale og øvrig dokumentation for egne arbejder. Materialet skal kunne gennemgås og koordineres inden udførelsen af de pågældende arbejder. Hovedentreprenøren skal uden unødigt ophold skriftligt gøre totalrådgiveren og bygherren opmærksomme på konstaterede fejl, uoverensstemmelser og uhensigtsmæssigheder i projektmaterialet samt bidrage med forslag til forbedring af bygbarhed og optimering af løsninger og udførelsesmetoder. Dette ændrer ikke på rådgivernes projekteringsansvar. Ved udarbejdelse og aflevering af digitalt materiale skal de relevante krav i udbudsmaterialets IKT-specifikation følges. Hovedentreprenøren skal udføre de projekteringsydelser, der følger af aftalegrundlaget, herunder nødvendig supplerende projektering, leverandørprojektering og teknisk detaljering vedrørende egne arbejder og leverancer. Hovedentreprenøren overtager ikke herved projekteringsansvaret for det af bygherrens rådgivere udarbejdede projekt. For entreprenørens projekteringsydelser finder AB 18 § 17 anvendelse. Møde- og koordineringsaktiviteter samt udarbejdelse og tilretning af produktionsgrundlag og arbejdsplaner er indeholdt i entreprisesummen. Hovedentreprenøren skal desuden foretage mængdeverificering efter udførelsesprojektets færdiggørelse og inden udførelsen igangsættes. // Den samlede anlægsramme er på 41.000.000 kr. eks. moms. // Det er forventningen, at hovedentreprisekontrakten indgås med den valgte tilbudsgiver d. 15. februar 2027.

title: Germany – Electrical wiring work – Gebäudeautomation - Neubau Zusammenlegung Müllstationen
description: Das Universitätsklinikum Düsseldorf plant den Bau einer zentralen Abfallsammelstelle, diese wird an der Stelle des heute bestehenden Gebäudes 18.15 errichtet werden. Die Zentrale Abfallsammelstelle (kurz ZAS) besteht aus einem rechteckigen Baukörper mit einer Kantenlänge von 56 x 56,50 m, welcher von einer Lochblechfassade allseitig eingefasst wird. Der Baukörper unterteilt sich in einen nach oben offenem Innenhof, um den ein L-förmiger zweigeschossiger Einbau angeordnet ist. Das Bauwerk wird in Stahlbeton Massivbauweise errichtet, das Tragwerk des teilüberdachten Hofes wird in Stahlbauweise errichtet. Die Erschließung für Fahrzeuge erfolgt über großes Ein- und Ausfahrtstore, die Erschließung für Personen erfolgt über ein, im zweigeschossigen Einbau verorteten Treppenkern mit Hydraulikaufzug. Das Bauwerk wird im Untergrund von Kanälen gekreuzt (ein Medientunnel und ein Kanal für den automatischen Warentransport), sowie auf einer in Teilen abgebrochene Bunkeranlage errichtet. Hieraus resultiert eine komplexe Gründungssituation über ein System aus Stützen, wandartigen Trägern und Bodenplatten. Das Gebäude erhält im UG einen Anschluss an den Kanal für automatischen Warentransport, sowie einen Entladungsbahnhof im EG. Alle tragenden Wände werden in Stahlbeton ausgeführt, nichttragende Innenwände werden aus 24er Porenbeton, Innenwände in Sanitärbereichen in Leichtbauweise errichtet.

title: Portugal – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Framework contract for EUDA scientific studies support services
description: The purpose of this procurement procedure is to purchase capacity to support the Agency in the preparation of high-quality scientific services and overall to increase the Agency’s timeliness, anticipatory and responsive capacity. The Agency requires access to supporting specialised expertise in the design, conduct, and reporting of different types of scientific work. Outputs may include reports, digital dashboards, AI based tools, methodological and reporting guidelines, training materials, workshops, databases, collection of literature, etc. The present procurement procedure is aimed at supporting the Agency to rapidly mobilise external expertise in a flexible and efficient manner, ensuring responsiveness to evolving scientific priorities and emerging evidence needs. The activities resulting from this procedure are expected to support the EUDA in monitoring drug markets, use of substances and their consequences. They will also help identify the evidence needed to inform responses in terms of establishing trends, examining emerging threats and tracking developments over time and between settings. Ultimately, this is expected to strengthen the preparedness of the Agency, and of the EU as a whole, to respond to drug-related harms.

description: In general, the Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to complete the contract requirements specified in Table 1 of this Performance Work Statement (PWS) except for those items specified as Government furnished property and services (see Part 3). Work to be accomplished includes, but is not limited to, conducting required environmental remediation services for which the United States Department of the Army (the �Army�) is statutorily responsible; addressing any and all environmental, explosive safety, scheduling, and regulatory issues; and assuming contractual liability and responsibility for the achievement of the contract requirements identified in the PWS. All the contamination associated with these sites shall be addressed including any that has migrated off the installation. 1.1.2 The Contractor shall comply with all applicable Federal, state and local laws and regulations and achieve the contract requirements of this PWS in a manner that is consistent with any applicable orders or permits, all existing cleanup agreements or guidance for the Installation, and relevant DOD and Army regulations, policies, and procedures, for the duration of the contract. 1.1.3 The Contractor shall perform all the necessary environmental remediation work required to meet the contract requirements of this PWS in a manner that is consistent with Comprehensive Environmental Response Compensation and Liability Act (CERCLA), as amended by the Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA), the National Oil and Hazardous Substances Contingency Plan (NCP) and the CERCLA Section 120 Federal Facility Agreement (FFA).non-severable environmental remediation services required to resolve mandatory Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (PADEP) regulatory comments, install additional sentinel and boundary groundwater monitoring wells, complete downhole borehole geophysics/packer testing, execute quarterly sampling of new wells, prepare addenda to the Quality Assurance Project Plan (QAPP) and Conceptual Site Model (CSM), and conduct one year of sitewide annual groundwater monitoring and fence inspections/repairs. title: B1142 HVAC Repair; Out of Scope Roof Modification
description: This document approves the award of a modification to a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Task Order (TO) Under contract FA251720D0004 under the Front Range Multiple Award Construction Contract (FRMACC) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ). The current TO FA251725F0154 is to provide HVAC work at Building 1142 (Project TDKA 10-1128). The intended action is to modify the current TO and include roof and lighting work for B1142. The justification is to award a modification to aforementioned on-going TO as it is in the interest of efficiency and economy. It is economically sound due to heavy equipment rentals/laborers/etc. that are already scheduled to be on site, alleviating additional mobilization and demobilization costs for a potentially different contractor if competed and awarded other than sole-source. This new requirement for roof replacement, lighting replacement, and interior finishes repair directly overlaps with ongoing work in the facility being performed by the current contractor. The Contractor is familiar with the facility, is in direct control of the construction schedule of HVAC replacement scope already awarded, and can execute the additional scope identified at a lower cost and shorter timeframe than other FRMACC contractors due to the efficiency of de-conflicting overlapping scopes. Positive impacts include assurance of proper sequencing of integrated work to avoid duplication of efforts and costs, elimination of warranty conflicts between contracts, and reduction of mission impact to execute consolidated scope in tandem in lieu of extended, multiple efforts displacing the mission owner on multiple occasions. Examples of overlapping scope with potential for duplicated costs and time include rooftop unit and associated curb placement/detailing on roof, roof-mounted utilities impacted by roof replacement, lighting and interior HVAC rework in tandem with ceiling replacement. Additionally, the roof conditions of this facility are in severe need of repair to mitigate ongoing mission impact in the facility, and are essential to be executed with urgency and without delay related to current awarded HVAC replacement work. This modification was executed by the 21st Contracting Squadron, located at 135 Dover St, Bldg 350, Suite 2225, Peterson Space Force Base, CO 80914. Olgoonik Enterprises, LLC (CAGE: 819A4) received the awarded modification for new work in the amount of $1,355,810.00. The modification was executed on 09/25/2026. Please submit all questions/concerns to the Contracting Officer at frederick.chartrand@spaceforce.mil.

title: RFI: Draft MIL-DTL for Militarized USB-C (USB-CM) - Feedback Request
description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP) or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The Program Manager � Protection and Integration (PM-PI) is seeking feedback on draft #2 of Military Detail document aka MIL-DTL for a new design for military connections. This draft incorporated comments from draft #1 and is subject to change based on relevant feedback and other developmental milestones of the program. Militarized USB-C aka �USB-CM� is an environmentally hardened connection built to survive military environments. The connector supports power and data requirements and supports USB standards unless specifically stated otherwise. This government owned design is intended to provide a standard interface for military equipment and is not proprietary. USB-CM is intended to provide a reliable and ruggedized standard connector for users across the Department of War in their deployed terrestrial, maritime: surface and sub-surface, air, and space operational environment(s). PM-PI is looking for public feedback on the second draft of MIL-DTL document including, but not limited to: USB-CM connector design, manufacturability, ability to integrate into vendor products, cost considerations, any perceived limitations of use, durability and corrosion resistance, materials, etc. It is encouraged that comments include tradeoffs in metrics, such as cost/data/design/testing as it relates to data rate and power levels. This is a refined second draft incorporating previous feedback. Please send all further comments to USB-CMilitary@army.mil. MS word or PDF is the preferred format. The draft MIL-DTL including design and detailed performance characteristics, can be found in the Attachments section of this posting. The Request for Information associated with this can be found at: https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/4202346c39ea4eefbf32929aae9dad1e/view

title: INTELLIGENCE, SURVEILLANCE, ANDRECONNAISSANCE (ISR) SYSTEMS AND INFORMATION OPERATIONS (IO) FROM SEABED TO SPACE (S2ISR)
description: Note: A Market Survey to Assess Small Business Capability was posted for this procurement on 05 March 2025 under E-Commerce control number MKTSVY-0019F306, REFERENCE NUMBER: N6600125R0025. The Naval Information Warfare Center (NIWC) Pacific intends to issue Request for Proposal (RFP) No. N6600126R0019 for Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) Systems and Information Operations (IO) from Seabed to Space (S2ISR). The services contemplated under this effort will provide the Navy with the ability to develop and field ISR systems that incorporate the latest capabilities for maintaining robust communication, surveillance, and security to accommodate advances in technology and other complementary systems while countering ever-increasing threats. The Government contemplates that, in its capacity, the contractor will provide technical support services in the form of algorithm development, data design processing, hardware and software development, fabrication, installation, testing, deployment, recovery, repair, systems engineering, program and configuration management, logistics, maintenance, sustainment, training, environmental support, and analysis in support of ISR activities, ISR systems, and corresponding cybersecurity operations. ISR activities may include support related to chemical, nuclear, biological, and radiological (CNBR) elements related to unmanned system. ISR systems may include surveillance programs, systems, networks, and tactical data communications systems including automated radio communications systems, satellite terminal systems, and space, air, land and water autonomous or non-autonomous systems that could be used in ISR operations. Contract activities may be performed throughout the world. In addition, work may be performed onboard afloat vessels (including U.S. Coast Guard vessels), in port, or at sea alongside coalition partner nations (e.g., NATO countries). title: RFI: Draft MIL-DTL for Militarized USB-C (USB-CM) - Feedback Request
description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP) or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The Program Manager � Protection and Integration (PM-PI) is seeking feedback on draft #2 of Military Detail document aka MIL-DTL for a new design for military connections. This draft incorporated comments from draft #1 and is subject to change based on relevant feedback and other developmental milestones of the program. Militarized USB-C aka �USB-CM� is an environmentally hardened connection built to survive military environments. The connector supports power and data requirements and supports USB standards unless specifically stated otherwise. This government owned design is intended to provide a standard interface for military equipment and is not proprietary. USB-CM is intended to provide a reliable and ruggedized standard connector for users across the Department of War in their deployed terrestrial, maritime: surface and sub-surface, air, and space operational environment(s). PM-PI is looking for public feedback on the second draft of MIL-DTL document including, but not limited to: USB-CM connector design, manufacturability, ability to integrate into vendor products, cost considerations, any perceived limitations of use, durability and corrosion resistance, materials, etc. It is encouraged that comments include tradeoffs in metrics, such as cost/data/design/testing as it relates to data rate and power levels. This is a refined second draft incorporating previous feedback. Please send all further comments to USB-CMilitary@army.mil. MS word or PDF is the preferred format. The draft MIL-DTL including design and detailed performance characteristics, can be found in the Attachments section of this posting. This Request for Information is associated with: RFI: Feedback on Draft MIL-DTL for Militarized USB-C (USB-CM) Connections dated 13 April 2026

description: Anskaffelsen omfatter etablering av rammeavtale for kjøp av elektroniske låser, alternative adgangsløsninger, reservedeler, tilbehør og annet nødvendig materiell til bruk i Bergen kommunes helse- og omsorgstjenester. Løsningene skal kunne integreres med kommunens eksisterende system for administrasjon av elektroniske låser og adgangsstyring (Unloc/Opencare).Formålet er å sikre en standardisert og driftssikker løsning som understøtter effektiv adgangshåndtering og legger til rette for god forvaltning, fleksibilitet og bærekraftig ressursutnyttelse i avtaleperioden. Det er besluttet at kommunens eksisterende låser, nøkkelbokser og releer skal erstattes i løpet av 2026 og 2027. Denne avtalen skal derfor legge til rette for anskaffelse og utskifting av et betydelig antall låser i avtaleperiodens innledende fase, samtidig som den skal dekke løpende behov for elektroniske låser, alternative alternative adgangsløsninger, reservedeler og annet nødvendig materiell.

title: Request for Information (RFI) Obtaining Food Franchise Rights in Washington, DC - National Capital Region (NCR)
description: Request for Information (RFI) : Obtaining Food Franchise Rights in Washington, DC - Northern Capital Region (NCR) The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to gather detailed input from qualified organizations regarding the requirements, processes, and opportunities associated with obtaining food franchise rights within the Northern Capital Region (NCR), Washington, DC. Organizations responding to this RFI are requested to provide all relevant documentation, points of contact, marketing materials, and procedural information. This RFI is for planning and informational purposes only and does not obligate the Government to pursue any further action or future solicitation. Direct Engagement Model � Industry Feedback Requested In addition to information on obtaining food franchise rights generally, the FBI is specifically interested in understanding the feasibility and attractiveness of a direct-engagement model, in which the FBI would contract or otherwise arrange directly with individual food franchise brands (rather than through a single master food-service contractor) to provide food service operations within the J. Edgar Hoover Building (JEH), Washington, DC. What the FBI should understand about this model: Typical franchise agreement structures, term lengths, and capital investment requirements (buildout, equipment, branding) when a franchisor/franchisee operates within a federal government-controlled facility rather than a traditional commercial or retail location Licensing, royalty, and territory considerations that may apply or require modification for a single-tenant government building Food safety, supply chain, and operational standards the franchise would need to meet or adapt to operate within a secure federal facility Any precedent for franchise operations within federal buildings, military installations, or other access-controlled environments, and lessons learned from those arrangements All responses must be submitted to: Ms. McKenzie P. Bucher, mpbucher@fbi.gov Mr. Tom Teets, twteets@fbi.gov Please provide all requested information no later than September 21, 2026, at 12:00 PM EDT.

title: ASTM Compass Subscription Renewal
description: PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE NOTICE CAREFULLY AS IT CONSTITUTES THE ONLY NOTICE THAT WILL BE ISSUED. description: Kainuun hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjouksia ortopedian erikoislääkäripalveluista Kainuun hyvinvointialueelle. Palvelua hankitaan vastaanottopalveluna kirurgian poliklinikalle, päivystyspalveluna vapaamuotoisena päivystyksenä viikonloppu- ja arkiviikkopäivystyksenä sekä leikkaussalipalveluna ja tarvittaessa osastotyöskentelynä kirurgisella osastolla. Vastaanottopalvelu käsittää poliklinikkapäiviä (noin 15 potilasta/päivä). Päiväaikaiseen työhön voi tilaajan tarpeiden mukaan sisältyä kirurgisen osaston osastotyö, puhelinkonsultaatiot, ja vastaanottotyö poliklinikalla tai leikkaustoiminta leikkausosastolla. Päivystyspalvelun vapaamuotoinen päivystys viikonloppupäivystyksenä, jolloin työ alkaa perjantaina klo 15.00 ja päättyy maanantaina klo 8.00 (aktiivityön määrä noin 30 - 50 %). Leikkaussalipalvelussa ortopediset toimenpiteet yhdessä leikkaussalissa klo 7.30 - 16.00. Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja kestää 31.12.2028 saakka. Lisäksi tilaaja varaa option yhdelle (1) vuodelle.

title: Netherlands – Public road transport services – Mobiliteitskaarten en aanverwante dienstverlening
description: Per 2026 zijn in de cao Werken voor Waterschappen nieuwe mobiliteitsafspraken opgenomen. Eén van deze afspraken is dat de werkgever de werknemer op diens verzoek een openbaarvervoerkaart ter beschikking kan stellen in ruil voor de bestaande vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. De directie van Waterschap AGV heeft op basis van het directievoorstel mobiliteitsregeling AGV besloten de mobiliteitsregeling in te voeren. Daarbij heeft de directie als uitgangspunten vastgesteld dat de regeling moet bijdragen aan: • duurzamer reisgedrag van medewerkers; • goed werkgeverschap; • het stimuleren van aanwezigheid en ontmoeting op kantoor; • een uitvoerbare en beheersbare inrichting van processen en systemen. Om deze directiekeuze tijdig, rechtmatig en doelmatig te kunnen uitvoeren, is het noodzakelijk een geschikte marktpartij te contracteren voor de levering en uitvoering van de openbaar vervoer voorziening. Het inkooptraject is erop gericht een contractpartij te selecteren die niet alleen de mobiliteitskaart levert, maar ook de bijbehorende dienstverlening kan bieden die nodig is voor implementatie, beheer, rapportage, ondersteuning van gebruikers en een verwerkbare aansluiting op HR-, financiële en salarisprocessen.

title: Netherlands – Sewage services – Raamovereenkomst Reinigen, preventief en correctief onderhoud mechanische installaties SWWB de Baronie 2027-2028
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de hoofdstuk 2 ARW 2016. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Deelnemers zijn naast de Gemeente Breda: Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau, Gemeente Gilze en Rijen, Baarle-Hertog en Gemeente Etten-Leur. Opdracht De opdracht betreft het reinigen en het preventief en correctief onderhouden van de mechanische installaties 2027-2028 binnen de deelnemende gemeenten van het Samenwerkingsverband Waterbeheer West-Brabant (SWWB). Percelen Deze opdracht is verdeeld in de volgende percelen: Perceel 1: ABG-organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda. Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de dienstverlening per perceel een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één opdrachtnemer met een looptijd van 2 jaar met als ingangsdatum 1 januari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft het recht deze overeenkomst, met tweemaal met één jaar te verlengen. De opdrachtgever zal minimaal 6 maanden voor het aflopen van het contract, de aannemer schriftelijk op de hoogte stellen of de opdrachtgever van de optie tot verlenging van het contract gebruik zal maken. Anders eindigt het contract automatisch na het bereiken van de einddatum. Minimale termijn van 6 maanden geldt ook voor de optie jaren. Eventuele verlenging geschiedt onder gelijkblijvende condities en voorwaarden. De opdrachtgevers kunnen elk individueel besluiten om al dan niet tot verlenging van de overeenkomst over te gaan zonder dat dit consequenties heeft in welke vorm dan ook voor de overige individuele opdrachtgevers. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op: Perceel 1: ABG- - organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog € 1.700.000,-; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur € 1.100.000,-; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda € 1.200.000-,. bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.
